narrative.overview:
The pinned EntityCulling reference establishes a bounded translucent dark pane, left title, compact upper-right addon selectors, top category tabs and concise native rows. Permanent and floor booleans use a left pixel check/cross. Minecraft owns the font, language, item textures and native controls; PanelButton supplies the flat framing.

Search sits below the scrolling list above stable Done, Cancel, Apply and Reset actions. English and Traditional Chinese follow active glyph metrics. Explanations remain complete in measured tooltips. Reliable scanning and interaction govern the surface.
keyCharacteristics: Left check/cross boolean rows and single-line labels.
Bottom search and fixed footer actions.
Native font, language, resources and complete tooltips.

rules.name: Source Palette
rules.body: Custom frames use PanelButton source colors; native widget textures and states stay owned by Minecraft resources.

rules.name: Complete Explanation
rules.body: Preserve full labels and explanations in measured tooltip line lists even when the visible row text is clipped.

dos: Do preserve the bounded pane, top navigation, left check/cross rows, bottom search and stable footer.
Do reuse Minecraft font, language, item textures and native controls.
Do preserve disabled values and complete tooltips.
Do verify current native captures in wide/compact English and Traditional Chinese layouts.
donts: Don't restore the rejected full-screen On/Off-button layout.
Don't invent tab icons or show icons on compact tabs.
Don't add rounded pills, decorative cards, custom display fonts or lift animations.
Don't expose performance/debug counters or claim a stale review is current acceptance.
